title: Round d: attribution of the six tiny-tier losses at HEAD
notes: All six losses reproduce deterministically at HEAD (not noise; fstar ok except LSNNODOC unverified/nan). HS30 trip/tfip: f within 5e-6..1.4e-5 of f*, kkt 2.7e-6..9.7e-6 > atol 1e-6 after mu reaches 1e-7 (10 updates), 500 steps (termination_missed). PRICE4B trip: f=3.6e-13, radius 1.5e-8, status trust_region_collapse. HS119 tfip: f matches f*, multiplier_solve_failure at mu 1e-7. LSNNODOC trip: f=123.112449 both before and after, fstar nan (unverified), now ends trust_region_collapse with kkt 18. HS55 tfip: now successful at f=6.6667 vs f*=6.3333 in 16 steps (before: 6.33333 in 32 steps): false success, protocol stop-and-ask. collapse_resets_secant True vs False: identical on 5 of 6, LSNNODOC trip 116 vs 123 steps only; the flag triggers but does not change outcomes. test_infeasible_run_reports_multiplier_bound_hits passes at HEAD. Common pattern: the new schedule drives mu to ~1e-7 where the end game (kkt noise above atol, multiplier solve, radius collapse) fails; old code stopped earlier.

notes: Group (ip_bound_slack_residual 1/31, unclassified/trust_region_collapse 1/42, ip_barrier_stall 0/49): trip 163->165 on the medium union, tfip unchanged. Gate G1 failed (needs >=3 on the 99 G1 tasks). Tiny trip: +3 gained, -1 lost (DEGENQP trip, successful -> max_steps kkt 4e-7). Tests 1718 passed.
